# OpenDocBot

> OpenDocBot is a privacy-first, zero-proxy Microsoft Office Add-in for Word, Excel and PowerPoint that connects directly to AI providers.

## Key Features
- Zero-Proxy Architecture: Direct client-to-LLM communication without intermediary servers.
- Privacy-First: No telemetry, no client tracking, local storage for API keys.
- Multi-Model: Supports Ollama (local LLMs), OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenCode, and other OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- Suggestion Mode: Read-only review; the agent adds native Word/Excel comments proposing changes instead of editing content.
- Skills: Reusable procedures scoped per Office app, following the open Agent Skills format (SKILL.md import/export).
- MCP: Connect external tools through the Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP). No auth, API key/bearer, or OAuth. Enabled per conversation, approval-gated by Human in the Loop.
- Sandboxed code execution: `execute_office_js` and `edit_slide_xml` run model-generated code in a restricted in-page sandbox with browser globals, common network and storage primitives, and host internals blocked.
